comment: ws129-p002: the components of a zedBSD image and their licenses, read by tools/release/license-inventory.py. when: always, program:NAME (selected userland package) or driver:CONFIG_NAME (kernel option y). notices: the files under /usr/share/licenses/ the image must carry for the component (empty when the license asks for none in binaries). paths: source path prefixes whose non-Zlib SPDX lines this component's notices cover. version: a literal, ext:NAME (ZEDBSD_EXT_NAME_VERSION) or empty. status: ok, gap (a notice the image lacks), decision (the user must decide) or decided (the user decided; decision: the date and source).

components.name: zedBSD (kernel, libc, base and desktop programs)
components.note: The zlib license asks for no notice in binaries; the image carries the project's license (the zedbsd-license package, always selected) as the list's first entry.

components.name: LLVM compiler-rt builtins (linked into every program)
libc regular expressions (musl libc, with TRE)
components.note: src/libc/regex/LICENSE holds TRE's BSD-2-Clause and musl's MIT texts; the zedbsd-license package installs it, as libc is in every image.

components.name: Khronos headers (EGL, GLES, Vulkan) in /usr/include
components.note: Each header carries its own license text, which travels with it into the development root filesystem.

components.name: Browser tables (Unicode data, WHATWG named character references)
Desktop fonts (Mahora, JetBrains Mono, Droid Sans Fallback)
NoctLang interpreter (/bin/noct)
components.note: Zlib asks for no notice in binaries. The clang resource headers in its tree are not installed.

components.name: Emacs editor (REmacs, /bin/emacs, userland/base/emacs)
components.upstream: userland/base/emacs (REmacs at 1a72439, taken into the tree 2026-10-04; its author licensed it under zlib)
components.note: 2026-10-04 user: taken into userland/base/emacs and licensed by its author under zlib; no special treatment (D1 closed).

components.name: Japanese input dictionary (from the Remacs dictionary)
components.upstream: the Remacs dictionary, copied into userland/desktop/ime/dict from userland/base/emacs/dict on 2026-10-04 (zlib)
components.note: Under the project's license file (ws095 D1).

components.name: SKK input dictionaries (from the Remacs dictionaries)
components.upstream: the Remacs SKK dictionaries SKK-JISYO.X and SKK-JISYO.remacs, copied into userland/desktop/ime/skk-dict from userland/base/emacs/dict on 2026-10-05 (zlib)
components.note: Under the project's license file (ws095 D1); no entry is copied from SKK-JISYO.L.

components.name: Clang, LLD, LLDB and LLVM tools
Hershey fonts (handwriting templates)
components.license: LicenseRef-Hershey-fonts (use for any purpose with the acknowledgements)
components.note: The Unicode mapping of the glyphs taken is from Kaloffl's Hershey-Unicode-Mapping (Unlicense).

components.name: Broadcom/Cypress UART Bluetooth firmware (Raspberry Pi 4, BCM4345C0)
components.upstream: RPi-Distro bluez-firmware; licence text from linux-firmware
components.note: Object code only, solely for use with Cypress integrated circuits (selected only by the Raspberry Pi 4 image); the licence forbids modification and reverse engineering.

components.name: Broadcom/Cypress BCM43455 SDIO WiFi firmware, CLM and NVRAM (Raspberry Pi 4)
components.license: LicenseRef-cypress-eula (redistribution allowed); the NVRAM values are also published under GPL-2.0-or-later
components.upstream: RPi-Distro firmware-nonfree; licence texts from linux-firmware
components.note: Firmware and CLM: object code only, solely for use with Cypress integrated circuits (selected only by the Raspberry Pi 4 image); the licence forbids modification and reverse engineering. The NVRAM is used as firmware-nonfree distributes it under the Cypress licence; linux-firmware publishes the same values under GPL-2.0+, so the GPL-2 text is installed with it. The NVRAM text is its own source form and no zedBSD code links with any of these files.
components.decision: 2026-10-13 user (WS206 E4): put the GPL licence file with the NVRAM

components.name: Intel Bluetooth firmware (AX211, Solar)
components.note: Unmodified binaries only; the licence forbids reverse engineering.

components.name: AMD Navi10 GPU firmware (PSP, SMU, GFX, SDMA)
components.note: Binary form only, unmodified, with the licence's notice and disclaimers; the licence forbids reverse engineering, decompilation and disassembly.

components.name: Arm Mali CSF GPU firmware (Mali-G310, ODROID-C5)
components.note: The whole software with its notices and the licence; use solely with Mali-based products; the licence forbids reverse engineering except as the law permits and is subject to export control laws.

components.name: ODROID-C5 bootloader (Amlogic S905X5M boot stages BL2-BL32 and Hardkernel's U-Boot)
components.license: LicenseRef-amlogic-boot-stages (only for use on the ODROID-C5) AND GPL-2.0-or-later (U-Boot)
components.upstream: Hardkernel's official ODROID-C5 image ubuntu-22.04-gnome-desktop-odroidc5-20260610-bsp-boot.img.xz, kept in the zedBSD firmware repository
components.note: The image's sectors 1-6538, written to the SD card's sectors 1-6538, not into the root file system. Amlogic's licence forbids redistribution and use without its prior written permission, which Hardkernel holds for its ODROID-C5 images; redistributed unmodified and only for use on the ODROID-C5. U-Boot is GPL-2.0 (the GPL-2 text is installed) and its source is Hardkernel's (github.com/hardkernel/u-boot branch odroidc5-v2023.01, commit c99f3409d5, on git.odroid.com; the notice).
components.decision: 2026-10-30 user (WS313): the bootloader of Hardkernel's ODROID-C5 image may be redistributed for use on this board, in the zedBSD firmware repository with Amlogic's licence; the official image itself is kept there unmodified

components.name: Imagination PowerVR Rogue GPU firmware (BXE-4-32, VisionFive 2)
components.note: Binary form only, unmodified, with the licence's notice and disclaimer; the licence forbids reverse engineering, decompilation and disassembly, and limits use to products licensed by Imagination.

components.name: NVIDIA GSP-RM firmware (Turing, Ampere, Ada)
components.note: Redistributed under the licence's open source exception (section 2.1.2): unmodified, for use on an operating system under an OSI-approved licence, with a copy of the licence; the licence forbids reverse engineering and translation and limits use to NVIDIA processors.

components.name: GTK 4
components.note: LGPL: outside the release image; adding it needs the user's decision (the guardrail keeps GPL-family code out).

components.name: GLib
components.note: LGPL: outside the release image; adding it needs the user's decision (the guardrail keeps GPL-family code out).

components.name: Pango
components.note: LGPL: outside the release image; adding it needs the user's decision (the guardrail keeps GPL-family code out).

components.name: cairo
components.note: Its license files are chosen by the package's Makefile; LGPL: outside the release image; adding it needs the user's decision (the guardrail keeps GPL-family code out).

components.name: GNU FriBidi
components.note: LGPL: outside the release image; adding it needs the user's decision (the guardrail keeps GPL-family code out).

components.name: GdkPixbuf
components.note: LGPL: outside the release image; adding it needs the user's decision (the guardrail keeps GPL-family code out).

components.name: FFmpeg libraries (libavutil, libswresample, libavcodec, libavformat, libswscale)
components.note: LGPL 2.1 or later as built (no --enable-gpl, --enable-version3 or --enable-nonfree; configure must report it). Shared libraries, so they can be replaced. In the image by the user's decision of 2026-10-05 (WS122: libavcodec and a simple player in beta 1); the corresponding source is the upstream tarball with no patches and the configure options in the package Makefile.
components.decision: 2026-10-05 user (WS122): libavcodec in the image from beta 1, with a simple player
